ask.instructions:
Ask the owner one to three questions that most affect the requirements.
Record each with `flow item question --text "..."`, then run `flow next` and end your reply.

capture.instructions:
Save each answer: `flow item answer <Q id> --text "..."`, or `--defer`, or `--withdraw`.
Write each requirement the answers settle: `flow item requirement --text "..."`.
Then run `flow next`.

decide.instructions:
Are more questions needed before the requirements are complete?
Run `flow next --decision more` or `flow next --decision ready`.

propose-approval.instructions:
Show the owner the full requirement list (`flow item show`) and ask for approval.
Run `flow item approve --propose`, then `flow next`, and end your reply.

record-approval.instructions:
Did the owner approve the requirements?
If yes: `flow item approve`, then `flow next --decision approved`.
If the owner asked for changes: `flow next --decision changes`.
